title: Ocean 13
meta_description: Discover Ocean 13, a stunning 7-bedroom retreat in Santa Rosa Beach with a private pool, hot tub, golf cart, and modern carriage house. Enjoy quick access to 30A’s beautiful beaches, top restaurants, and family-friendly activities. Book your getaway today!
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love • Private swimming pool and hot tub (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax) • Golf cart available for easy beach access • 6 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bicycles • Elevator in the main home • Beach Towels Included • Sonos Sound System • Expansive living and dining areas with floor-to-ceiling windows • Chef’s kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and butler’s pantry • Wet bar and multiple spaces for quiet conversation • En suite bathrooms and full-sized washer and dryer • Lovely carriage house with modern amenities • Conveniently located off 30A: 3 Min walk to beach, restaurants, and activities • 5 Minutes Bike ride to SeasideEscape to Ocean 13, a magnificent home in Santa Rosa Beach! This stunning retreat is perfect for your next getaway, featuring a private swimming pool, hot tub, elevator, breathtaking views, and ample space for your entire group. A convenient golf cart provides easy access to the beach, and a lovely carriage house with modern amenities offers additional privacy. Located just off 30A, you’ll have quick access to beautiful beaches, fantastic restaurants, and plenty of family-friendly activities during your stay!Ocean 13 is a gorgeous home with seven bedrooms and seven baths, accommodating up to twenty-four guests. Beautifully furnished and fully equipped, this stunning retreat offers the ultimate in contemporary living. Hardwood floors, high ceilings, and thoughtful finishes enhance the design, ensuring the best experience during your vacation. The spacious living and dining areas are bright and open, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing outstanding views. Gather in the living room to catch up on your favorite shows on the flat-screen TV, then step outside for an evening dip in the pool or a soak in the hot tub. The sizeable chef’s kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, an oversized island with seating for four, and a butler’s pantry, making meal prep enjoyable and easy with friends and family nearby. The home offers several beautiful spaces for quiet conversation, each providing a tranquil escape from the hurried pace of everyday life. Bedrooms and bathrooms are luxuriously appointed, with four king-sized beds, five queen-sized beds, and two twin-over-queen bunk beds, ensuring everyone enjoys a comfortable and relaxing stay. Additional conveniences include a wet bar, en suite bathrooms, a poolside outdoor half bath, a dedicated workout room, and two full-sized washers and dryers.Relax by the private pool or venture to the sugar-white shores just minutes away. The Seaside town center is a short walk or bike ride, offering fabulous boutique shopping and excellent restaurants. Enjoy lunch at The Great Southern Cafe or Bud and Alley’s, with stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico. Rent bikes, hop on the Timpoochee Trail, and explore neighboring communities like Seacrest, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach. Every day is an adventure on 30A!Book your stay at this 30A Luxury Vacations property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.Bedroom Details: First Floor: •Bedroom 1: King-sized bed Second Floor: • Bedroom 2: King-sized bed • Bedroom 3: King-sized bed • Bedroom 4: King-sized bed • Bedroom 5: Two Queen - sized beds and two twin-over-queen bunk beds Third Floor: • Bedroom 6: Two Queen - sized beds Carriage House: • Bedroom 7: Queen-sized bed
